eligibility.evidence: Abstract, Sec ChildBench Construction, Table 1-2: new multimodal benchmark of 10 visual tasks (counting, odd-one-out, paper folding, tracking) 'inspired by early childhood cognitive development'. No classic paradigm named and no source human study cited for any task (related work cites only datasets and benchmarks), so E2 operational test fails. Human reference is two 5-year-olds on 100 items. A reviewer could treat the developmental framing as a DEV paradigm.

A.title: Easy for Children, Hard for AI: The Limits of Multimodal LLMs in Early Childhood Learning
A.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-26)

G.notes: Benchmark paper; tasks built by the authors in Canva with templates, no cited cognitive-psychology source. Human comparison is two children, 100 items, 96 percent accuracy. Referee would ask whether any task derives from a published developmental paradigm.
